=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:598-607 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_heal_regression_budget_only`, the backticked Files-bullet branch (`ticked = re.search(r"`([^`]+)`", bullet.group(1))`) always takes the first backticked span as the file, so a bullet like "- Raise `PHASE_TIMEOUT` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`" records `PHASE_TIMEOUT`; and because BULLET_RE allows up to 3 leading spaces, a nested sub-bullet is also read as a file (for example `timeout-minutes`).
  WHY: The recorded "file" fails the HEAL_RG_WORKFLOW_PATH_RE check at lines 619-621, so the function returns False and a timeout-only plan is approved as `not_a_regression` / `regression_named` instead of being held as `budget_only_plan`, while the same plan written without backticks is held; reviewers disagree on severity (sonnet and glm say MAJOR, gemini, minimax and openai say NIT), and the highest (MAJOR→high) is used.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:614 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: HEAL_RG_COMPANION_PATH_RE (`^(?:tests/\S+|changelog\.d/[^/\s]+\.md|agents\.d/[^/\s]+\.md)$`) removes every `tests/**` path from the Files list before the budget-only test, and test_regression_budget_only_ignores_companion_files_and_context_sections locks this behaviour in.
  WHY: Issue #8543 holds only plans whose Files section "names only the failing workflow", so a plan that lists and fixes `tests/test_slow.py` along with `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is falsely held as `budget_only_plan`.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:629-639 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Outside the context sections, any UPPER_SNAKE identifier that is not a knob makes `_heal_regression_budget_only` return False, even when the plan only mentions it (for example "leave `CACHE_KEY_PREFIX` unchanged" or "leave `MAX_PARALLEL` unchanged"), so mentioning an identifier is treated the same as changing it.
  WHY: A plan that only raises PHASE_TIMEOUT escapes the `budget_only_plan` hold and is auto-approved, which is the incident shape the gate exists to catch; glm rates confidence 3 and notes that the docstring (559-568) documents this as a deliberate heuristic, and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly declined this finding as a documented, deliberate assumption.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:581-616 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The budget-only classifier returns False when the plan text contains uppercase identifiers that are neither budget knobs nor context tokens (for example `CACHE_KEY_PREFIX`).
  WHY: A plan that changes only timeout/budget knobs but mentions such an identifier fails the budget-only classification and passes the regression gate when it should be held (same root cause as the 629-639 entry, kept separate because the cited line ranges do not overlap or abut).
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:523-540 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_heal_regression_line`, the not-a-regression form runs `HEAL_RG_PLACEHOLDER_RE.match(reason)` (`^<[^<>]*>$`) without first stripping backticks, so `HEAL_REGRESSION: not a regression: `<reason>`` is accepted as a real reason, unlike the named form, which strips backticks (546-548).
  WHY: A planner that copies the backticked placeholder gets past the empty-reason hold and the line is classified `not_a_regression`; all flagging reviewers rate it NIT (confidence 3-4), and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputed it, saying the prompts backtick the whole line, so a literal copy starts with a backtick, does not match HEAL_RG_LINE_RE, and already holds as `no_line`.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:_heal_regression_budget_only, lines 605-607 (BULLET_RE at line 70) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The backtick branch takes the first backticked span as the file whether or not it is a path ("- Raise `PHASE_TIMEOUT` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`" records `PHASE_TIMEOUT`), and BULLET_RE's 0-3 leading spaces make a nested sub-bullet ("  - raise `timeout-minutes` to 120") another file.
  WHY: The value fails HEAL_RG_WORKFLOW_PATH_RE (lines 619-621), the function returns False, and parse_heal_regression approves as `regression_named` / `not_a_regression` instead of holding `budget_only_plan`, so the hold depends on markup. Suggested fix: take the first backticked span that contains "/" or matches HEAL_RG_EXT_RE, otherwise fall back to the path-like-word selection.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:HEAL_RG_COMPANION_PATH_RE, line 614 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Every `tests/**` path is dropped from the Files list before the budget-only test (locked in by test_regression_budget_only_ignores_companion_files_and_context_sections).
  WHY: A plan with Files `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `tests/test_slow.py`, plus `HEAL_REGRESSION: tests/test_slow.py`, is falsely held as `budget_only_plan`, which is wider than the issue's "names only the failing workflow" rule. Suggested fix: ignore only the changelog.d and agents.d companions, or keep any companion path that the HEAL_REGRESSION line names.
- HARDENING: scripts/partial_delivery.py:_heal_regression_budget_only, Files-bullet parsing (lines 603-611); indented sub-bullets are read as extra file entries. Fix: record a Files entry only when the token contains "/" or matches HEAL_RG_EXT_RE (3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- NOTES: Declined the "leave CACHE_KEY_PREFIX unchanged" finding (documented deliberate assumption in the docstring) and the backticked `<reason>` finding (a literal copy starts with a backtick and already holds as `no_line`). Says the plan.yml changes are correct. CI status is unknown because check-run collection timed out.
